verses.en: The Imminent Happening!
What is the Imminent Happening?
And what can let you know what the Imminent happening is?
Thamūd and ‘Ād had denied (the happening of) the Shocking Event (the Day of Judgment).
As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by that (dreadful cry), which exceeded all limits.

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاُهۡلِكُوۡا بِرِيۡحٍ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۙ‏
verses.en: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a violent windstorm

verses.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٍ وَّثَمٰنِيَةَ اَيَّامٍۙ حُسُوۡمًا فَتَرَي الۡقَوۡمَ فِيۡهَا صَرۡعٰيۙ كَاَنَّهُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۚ‏
verses.en: that He imposed on them for seven nights and eight consecutive days; so you could see them thrown on the ground, as if they were trunks of hollow palm-trees.
Now, do you see any remnant of them?

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَنۡ قَبۡلَهٗ وَالۡمُؤۡتَفِكٰتُ بِالۡخَاطِئَةِۚ‏
verses.en: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and those before him and the overthrown towns came up with evil,

verses.ar: فَعَصَوۡا رَسُوۡلَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ اَخۡذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.en: and they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an extremely severe seizure.

verses.ar: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنٰكُمۡ فِي الۡجَارِيَةِۙ‏
verses.en: When the water overflowed (in the Deluge of NūH), We let you (O mankind,) board the floating ship,

verses.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةً وَّتَعِيَهَا٘ اُذُنٌ وَّاعِيَةٌ
verses.en: so that We make it a reminder for you, and so that a preserving ear (that hears their story) may preserve it.

verses.ar: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ نَفۡخَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌۙ‏
verses.en: Then, once the Trumpet will be blown for the first time,

verses.ar: وَّحُمِلَتِ الۡاَرۡضُ وَالۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَّاحِدَةًۙ‏
verses.en: and the earth and the mountains will be lifted and crushed into pieces with a single blow,
then on that Day the Happening will happen,
and the sky will burst apart, while it will have become frail on that day.

verses.ar: وَّالۡمَلَكُ عَلٰ٘ي اَرۡجَآئِهَاؕ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌؕ‏
verses.en: And the angels will be on its borders. And on that Day, the Throne of your Lord will be carried above them by eight (angels).

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ تُعۡرَضُوۡنَ لَا تَخۡفٰي مِنۡكُمۡ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.en: On that day, you will be brought forward in a way that no secret of yours will remain secret.

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖ فَيَقُوۡلُ هَآؤُمُ اقۡرَءُوۡا كِتٰبِيَهۡۚ‏
verses.en: Now, as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say (to his colleagues), “Come here, read my book.
I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”
So he will be in a well-pleasing life
in a lofty garden,
the fruits of which will be close at hand.

verses.ar: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا٘ اَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَيَّامِ الۡخَالِيَةِ
verses.en: (It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اُوۡتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِشِمَالِهٖ ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اُوۡتَ كِتٰبِيَهۡۚ‏
verses.en: As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,
and I had never known what my account is!
Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!
My wealth has not been of any use to me.
My power has gone from me for good.”
(Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,
and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ فِيۡ سِلۡسِلَةٍ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُوۡنَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسۡلُكُوۡهُؕ‏
verses.en: Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”

verses.ar: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,
and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
So, he has no friend here today,
nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,
which is eaten by none but the sinners.
I swear by what you see,
and what you do not see,
it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).

verses.ar: وَّمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,

verses.ar: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٍؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.
It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,
We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,
and then severed his life-artery,

verses.ar: فَمَا مِنۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حٰجِزِيۡنَ
verses.en: and none of you could have saved him from it.
It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.
And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.
And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.
And it is surely an absolute truth.
So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.
